tagline: A leading technology and analytics company focused on providing online financial services.
hero_kpi_rationale: The KPI "Total Credit Extended" is the Hero because it represents the primary indicator of the company's activity, which is providing online financial services through loans and financing to consumers and small businesses.

kpis.name: Total Credit Extended
kpis.explanation: The total amount of credit extended to borrowers.
kpis.description: Total credit extended is a key indicator of the company's core business activity.

kpis.name: Number of Customer Transactions
kpis.explanation: The total number of transactions completed by customers since launch in 2004.
kpis.description: The cumulative number of customer transactions is an indicator of the size and engagement level of the company's customer base.

kpis.short: Number of States with Consumer Loans
kpis.name: Number of States with Consumer Loans
kpis.explanation: The number of U.S. states and countries where the company offers consumer loans.
kpis.description: Presence in 37 U.S. states and Brazil reflects growing geographic coverage for consumer lending services.

kpis.short: Number of States with Small Business Financing
kpis.name: Number of States with Small Business Financing
kpis.explanation: The number of U.S. states and Washington D.C. where the company offers small business financing.
kpis.description: Presence in 49 U.S. states and Washington D.C. reflects near-national geographic coverage for small business financing services.

kpis.name: Machine Learning-Enabled Models
kpis.explanation: The percentage of models using machine learning in the company's analytical environment.
kpis.description: Approximately 90% of the models used in the analytical environment are powered by machine learning, reflecting the importance of AI in credit underwriting and loan management decisions.
kpis.signal: Technological sophistication and investment in AI

kpis.name: Number of Transactions Processed in 2025
kpis.explanation: The number of transactions processed by the company during the year 2025.
kpis.description: The number of transactions processed in 2025 (4.3 million) is a key indicator of the company's annual transaction processing volume.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Credit risk is high due to the nature of the company's activities, which involve extending loans and financing to consumers and small businesses. Default on these loans could have a significant impact on the company's financial results.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the countries where it operates, particularly in the United States and Brazil. Changes in these regulations could negatively impact the company's operations. Compliance with the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau regulatory authority represents a significant burden.

risks.title: Competitive Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive market, with numerous players offering similar services. Competition could lead to pricing pressure and reduced margins.

risks.title: Technological Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on its technology to deliver services. Technical issues or cyberattacks could negatively impact operations.

risks.title: Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company's reputation is critical to attracting and retaining customers. Negative incidents or service issues could harm the company's reputation.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in multiple countries, exposing it to geopolitical risks. Political changes or conflicts could negatively impact operations, particularly in Brazil where it also operates.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company processes sensitive customer information and has accumulated over 95 terabytes of accessible customer behavioral data. Cyberattacks or security breaches could significantly impact the company's reputation and operations.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company must maintain sufficient liquidity to fund its operations and repay its debts. Liquidity issues could negatively impact business activities.

ai_positioning.summary: Enova significantly integrates artificial intelligence and machine learning into its operations. The company employs proprietary underwriting systems based on advanced risk analytics, including machine learning and AI, to make financing approval decisions and optimize loan terms. Approximately 90% of the models used in the company's analytical environment are powered by machine learning, demonstrating substantial operational reliance on AI technology.
evidence: Proprietary underwriting systems based on advanced risk analytics, including machine learning and artificial intelligence
Approximately 90% of the models used in the analytical environment are powered by machine learning
Over 21 years of customer behavioral data collected and used to continuously refine analytical models
Statistical machine learning models used for credit, purchasing, marketing and collections decisions
